text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder displays incredible skill in a pre-debut scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The media in attendance compare her to Maruzensky, a racer known as the "Beast."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder refuses to play second fiddle, and resolves to overcome her upperclassman.
